usdRate.sourceName: Banco Central del Paraguay, reference exchange rate (non-financial clients market), close 30 October 2026
usdRate.note: Mid of the closing buy 5,910.01 and sell 5,929.37 guaranies per dollar on 30 October 2026. On re-check (3 November 2026) the BCP page only showed the 2 November close (about 5,965-5,981) and Trading Economics gave 5,917 on 3 November, consistent with this level; the guarani appreciated sharply in 2026 (World Bank average 7,545 for 2025).

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics, Paraguay inflation rate (Banco Central del Paraguay CPI)
inflation_cpi.note: Secondary source: year-on-year CPI inflation 1.7% in September 2026 (1.5% in August); the BCP site blocks automated reading. World Bank gives 4.0% for 2025.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Banco Central del Paraguay inflation target 3.5% (reported by Trading Economics, October 2026 decision)
inflation_projection.note: The BCP targets 3.5% and expectations are anchored there, so we plan with the target although current inflation (1.7%) is lower.

policy_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Paraguay interest rate (BCP monetary policy committee, 23 October 2026)
policy_rate.note: Secondary source: BCP policy rate (TPM) held at 5.50% at the October 2026 meeting; the BCP site blocks automated reading.

savings_account_rate.note: The BCP publishes average deposit rates by type, but its pages block automated reading (Cloudflare challenge) and no other public source with a 2026 savings account rate was found.

fdr_3m_rate.note: BCP average rates for short fixed-term deposits could not be read (site blocks automated access); no other public 2026 figure found.

fdr_1y_rate.note: BCP average rates for 1-year savings certificates (CDA) could not be read (site blocks automated access); no other public 2026 figure found.

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate was found in Paraguay.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average rate paid by banks on deposits, 2021 (older than 2025; the series has no later value and the BCP rate tables could not be read).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found; the Ministry of Economy and Finance sells Treasury bonds through the stock exchange (see tbond rows).

tbill_91d_rate.note: No regular 91-day Treasury bill auction by the Ministry of Economy and Finance was found in its 2026 news; short-term central bank paper (IRM) is sold to banks, not individuals.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Ministerio de Economia y Finanzas: Treasury bond auction, bond maturing 2030
tbond_5y_rate.note: MEF auction of 23 September 2026 (reopening, via the Asuncion stock exchange): allotment yield 8.26% on the bond maturing in 2030 (about 4 years remaining), 24 basis points below July.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Ministerio de Economia y Finanzas: Treasury bond auction, bond maturing 2035
tbond_10y_rate.note: MEF auction of 23 September 2026 (reopening, via the Asuncion stock exchange): allotment yield 8.70% on the bond maturing in 2035 (about 9 years remaining), 30 basis points below July.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Paraguay individual taxes on personal income (reviewed 19 October 2026)
tax_bank_interest.note: PwC lists interest on money deposits among capital income (rentas del capital), whose personal income tax (IRP) rate is 8%; exemptions in Law 6380/2019 (e.g. for some securities) could not be checked because the tax authority site was unreachable.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate for individuals exists in Paraguay (see sanchayapatra_5y_rate), so no tax rate applies.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: Paraguay has a Deposit Guarantee Fund (Fondo de Garantia de Depositos) run by the BCP, but its page and the law text could not be read (sites block automated access or were unreachable), so the coverage amount was not confirmed.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: The BCP publishes maximum credit card rates, but its pages block automated reading; no other public 2026 figure found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Paraguay Treasury bond yields 8.26-8.70% (MEF, September 2026); no usable local equity index
equity_return_low.note: Low case: the Asuncion stock exchange trades few shares, so savers rely on global equity in guarani terms, and a weak decade is possible.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Paraguay Treasury bond yields 8.26-8.70% (MEF, September 2026); global equity in guarani terms
equity_return_base.note: No local equity index with a 10-year record exists, so the base uses global equities in guarani terms (about 7% in dollars plus slight guarani depreciation), below the 7.6% after-tax bond yield plus 4 points.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Paraguay Treasury bond yields 8.26-8.70% (MEF, September 2026); global equity in guarani terms
equity_return_high.note: High case if global equities repeat strong dollar returns and the guarani weakens.

gold_return_low.sourceName: BCP reference exchange rate (about 5,920 guaranies per dollar, October 2026, after strong appreciation from 7,545 in 2025)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: weak dollar gold price while the guarani stays strong.

gold_return_base.sourceName: BCP reference exchange rate (about 5,920 guaranies per dollar, October 2026); World Bank average 7,545 for 2025
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4.5% plus about 1 point of guarani depreciation a year over the long run.

gold_return_high.sourceName: BCP reference exchange rate (about 5,920 guaranies per dollar, October 2026)
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold prices and a weaker guarani.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: BCP policy rate 5.50% (October 2026); 8% personal income tax on interest
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: savings and short deposits below the policy rate, after 8% tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: BCP policy rate 5.50%; Treasury bond yields 8.26-8.70% (September 2026); 8% tax on interest
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of term deposits near the policy rate and Treasury bonds, after 8% personal income tax.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Treasury bond yields 8.26-8.70% (MEF, September 2026); 8% tax on interest
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: holding Treasury bonds at about 7.6-8% after tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The Superintendencia de Seguros (BCP) publishes insurer statistics, but its pages block automated reading; no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold in Paraguay, but no regulator or public source publishing premium rates by age was found; only individual insurer quotes exist.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No official or public figure for a typical major private hospital stay in Paraguay was found (Ministry of Health and IPS sites unreachable).

health_premium_table.note: No published private health plan (medicina prepaga) premiums by age from a regulator or public source were found.

goal_inflation_health.note: No long-run medical CPI series could be read; planning inflation plus 1.5 points for private medical costs.

goal_inflation_education.note: No long-run education CPI series could be read; planning inflation plus 1.5 points for private school and university fees.

life_expectancy.note: UN WPP 2024 (via populationpyramid.net) gives 74.2 for 2026 (men 71.3, women 77.4).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 10.35 (2025, World Bank), 14.7 (2040) and 28.2 (2065, https://www.populationpyramid.net/paraguay/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Ministerio de Economia y Finanzas, presentation on the Caja Fiscal reform (14 January 2026): comparison with IPS parameters
retirement_age_default.note: IPS (Instituto de Prevision Social) ordinary retirement: minimum age 60 with 25 years of contributions, 100% replacement rate; early (extraordinary) retirement from 55 with 30 years.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Ministerio de Economia y Finanzas, Caja Fiscal presentation (January 2026): ordinary retirement parameters by sector
retirement_age_government.note: General public administration (Caja Fiscal): minimum ordinary retirement age 62 with 20-40 years of contributions (47-100% replacement). A January 2026 reform bill proposes uniform rules (62 with 30 years); whether it has been enacted was not confirmed.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: BCP policy rate 5.50% (October 2026); 8% tax on interest
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: mostly savings and short deposits after 8% tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: BCP policy rate 5.50% (October 2026); 8% tax on interest
retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept below the policy rate after tax (about 5.1%), as 1-year deposit rates could not be read; liquid deposits in retirement.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: part of savings in Treasury bonds at about 7.6% after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Treasury bond yields 8.26-8.70%; global equity in guarani terms
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if equities disappoint.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Treasury bond yields 8.26-8.70%; global equity in guarani terms
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: half equities at 8.5% and half deposits and bonds around 5%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Treasury bond yields 8.26-8.70%; global equity in guarani terms
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case with stronger equity returns and bonds held to maturity.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: HelpAge International, Pension Watch: Paraguay (Pension Alimentaria para Adultos Mayores)
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Poverty-targeted social pension from age 65 paid to over 375,000 people (MEF, August 2026); 724,762 guaranies is 25% of the 2025 minimum wage (2,899,048), so it likely rose in July 2026 with the new minimum wage (about 3,044,000); paid by the Ministry of Social Development.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Pension Alimentaria para Adultos Mayores: age 65 for men and women, targeted at people in poverty; covers about 61% of people 60+.

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Code provides an indemnity on unjustified dismissal, but its text and the Labour Ministry site were unreachable, so whether any statutory payment applies at retirement could not be confirmed.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Ministerio de Economia y Finanzas, Caja Fiscal reform presentation (14 January 2026): IPS parameters
public_pension_scheme.note: IPS compulsory contributory scheme for private employees: ordinary pension at 60 with 25 years of contributions (100% of the reference wage); early pension from 55 with 30 years. Automatic indexation and tax treatment could not be confirmed (IPS site unreachable), so inflationLinked is set false; a 2026 reform bill proposes indexing public-sector pensions to the minimum wage.

savings_account.note: Offered by banks and finance companies; no public 2026 rate could be read.

fdr_3m.note: Short fixed-term deposits are offered by banks; no public 2026 rate could be read.

fdr_1y.note: The usual term deposit product for 1 year or more; no public 2026 rate could be read.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: No regular 91-day Treasury bill auction was found; the BCP's short-term monetary regulation instruments are for banks.

tbond_5y.note: Auctioned by the Ministry of Economy and Finance through the Asuncion stock exchange; individuals buy through licensed brokers.

tbond_10y.note: Auctioned by the Ministry of Economy and Finance through the Asuncion stock exchange.

equity_fund.note: Local investment funds are mostly money-market and fixed-income; no diversified local equity or index fund for retail was confirmed.

gold.note: No legal restriction on buying gold; mostly sold as jewellery.

insuranceRegulator.name: Superintendencia de Seguros, Banco Central del Paraguay

insuranceComplaints.name: Superintendencia de Seguros, Banco Central del Paraguay
insuranceComplaints.note: No separate insurance ombudsman; complaints go to the Superintendencia de Seguros.

oldAgeAllowance.name: Pensión Alimentaria para Adultos Mayores, Ministerio de Desarrollo Social

publicHealthCover.name: Ministerio de Salud Pública y Bienestar Social (free public health services)

depositInsurance.name: Fondo de Garantía de Depósitos (Banco Central del Paraguay)
